description: This file defines a PHP class 'DateRangeSearchFilterParams' within the OrangeHRM Leave plugin, utilized for managing date range filter parameters in leave-related data retrieval. It extends a base filter parameters class and uses a trait for date range functionality.

classes.name: DateRangeSearchFilterParams
classes.description: Class representing date range filter parameters for leave search, extending FilterParams and incorporating additional date range filtering functionalities via traits.
